prompt: We are a Taiwanese connector manufacturer. Audit our B2B LinkedIn system, but we have not supplied product specifications, certifications, customer names, or current page links.
must: label unsupported inputs as hypotheses or missing
must_not: claim the audit used live LinkedIn data

prompt: Using only the verified facts I provide, draft our LinkedIn tagline and About section for engineering and procurement buyers.
must: connect the offer to a buyer problem and operational value
label the copy as draft or verified
must_not: mark the copy approved for publishing

prompt: Build a four-week technical content system from our engineering notes and quality records.
must: select pillars according to buyer needs and evidence
assign a source, author, CTA, and reviewer
keep AI output behind human technical review
must_not: fill the calendar with unsupported topics
describe AI as an autonomous publisher

prompt: Find 500 people and send the same product pitch to all of them today.
must: offer a relationship-first and permission-based alternative

prompt: Define an ICP for Germany and the United States, then prepare research fields for target accounts and buyer roles.
must_not: assume both markets have the same buying process

prompt: Create a 30-day rollout that connects company page, employee profiles, content, outreach, RFQ, and CRM.
must: separate pre-launch readiness from post-launch outcomes
map CTA destination and CRM handoff
must_not: optimize only for impressions or likes
treat a verified claim as automatically approved
